instruction.text: Read and listen to the short story.

atoms.text: This porcupine lives next to a pond. Lots of animals live there.
atoms.sound: ssml: The little porcupine. <break time='1000ms'/>This porcupine lives next to a pond. Lots of animals live there.

atoms.text: She likes to sleep during the day and find food at night. Her favourite food is berries. Yum!
Sometimes she even eats roots, buds and fruits.
This porcupine also likes to play hide-and-seek. She always knows a good spot!
The little porcupine finds a warm, dry home. She grunts and squeaks happily. Squeak, Squeak!
She may be small, but this little porcupine has about 30,000 quills on her back!
But, she doesn’t want to scare anyone. They are normally smooth to touch.
She only makes them pointy when she is worried. The little porcupine is happy.

hint.text: The main idea is the most important message.

b.sound: A porcupine lives near a pond and is happy.
A grumpy porcupine has a lot of quills.
